title: 焚化煙氣袋濾除塵
summary: 本課以「由濾餅、配流與差壓理解袋濾除塵與破袋診斷」為主軸，依序處理入口粉塵負荷、濾餅累積與阻力、出口濃度與去除率、破袋事件的時間延遲、分室診斷可信度。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Understand bag filtration and failure diagnosis through cake, flow distribution and differential pressure, progressing through Inlet dust loading, Cake accumulation and resistance, Outlet concentration and removal, Timing of a bag-failure signal, Confidence in compartment diagnosis. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 入口粉塵負荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Inlet dust loading: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 入口粉塵負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Inlet dust loading and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 入口濃度與實際處理氣量共同決定濾袋每天承受的粉塵，不只看濃度百分比。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。
steps.instructionEn: Inlet concentration and gas flow jointly determine dust presented to the bags; concentration alone is insufficient. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
steps.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「入口粉塵負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Inlet dust loading flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「入口粉塵負荷」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Inlet dust loading, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

steps.title: 濾布面積與過濾風速：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Cloth area and filtration velocity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 濾布面積與過濾風速 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Cloth area and filtration velocity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 計算在線面積時扣除停用濾室，並對照分室氣流而非假定均勻。 過濾風速由實際氣量除以可用布面積；隔離一室時其餘濾袋負荷會上升。
steps.instructionEn: Subtract isolated compartments from online area and compare compartment flows rather than assuming uniformity. Air-to-cloth velocity is actual flow divided by available area; isolating one compartment increases loading on the others.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：氣體流量 Q=60 m³/min；有效濾布面積 A=120 m²。公式 v=Q/A，計算得 0.5 m/min。適用邊界：平均配流近似且氣量與溫壓一致，不代表濾料容許值。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Gas flow Q=60 m³/min; effective cloth area A=120 m². Formula v=Q/A gives 0.5 m/min. Applicability: Mean-flow approximation at consistent gas conditions, not a permitted fabric loading.
steps.failure: 把停用濾袋計入面積，會低估在線風速。 在「濾布面積與過濾風速」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Counting unavailable bags understates online filtration velocity. Mark where this error can enter the Cloth area and filtration velocity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「濾布面積與過濾風速」，核對在線濾袋數、實際氣量與分室差壓，辨識局部超載。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
